# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

She pays attention to her fashion, wearing flounced dresses and owning an evening dress. When she visits Anne at Queen's Academy, she is seen in town boardings.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is direct, opinionated, and often disagreeable or spiteful toward her peers. She shows little self-restraint or sensitivity, unceremoniously making blunt remarks about others' physical appearances, emotional states, or personal backgrounds. She lacks a romantic or imaginative disposition, openly disliking school recitations and expressiveness. Despite her sharp tongue, she participates in social calls and group activities within her school circle.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Traits

- Blunt and critical  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- Unimaginative  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- Daredevil or provocative  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Abilities

- Lace-knitting

## Goals

- To attend Queen's Academy and pursue her studies without being homesick  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye grows up in Avonlea and attends the local school alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and their peers. During a social gathering, she dares Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Following the accident, Josie visits the recovering Anne at Green Gables. She later prepares for and successfully passes the entrance examinations for Queen's Academy. Upon moving to town to study at Queen's, she boards at the same residence as Frank Stockley and visits Anne in her boarding room.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Avonlea as part of the Pye family  <sub>[v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School under Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’ve no intention of being homesick, I can tell you. Town’s too jolly after that poky old Avonlea. I wonder how I ever existed there so long. You shouldn’t cry, Anne; it isn’t becoming, for your nose and eyes get red, and then you seem all red.  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
